title.en: Lost Medicaid in Alabama? Your 2026 Coverage Options

description.en: Lost Alabama Medicaid in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in ACA marketplace coverage. ALL Kids (CHIP) covers children year-round.
description.es: Perdio Medicaid en Alabama en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para inscribirse en el mercado ACA. Alabama no expande Medicaid, pero ALL Kids y opciones federales aplican.

h1.en: Lost Your Medicaid in Alabama in 2026? Here Are Your Next Steps
h1.es: Perdio Su Medicaid en Alabama en 2026? Aqui Estan Sus Proximos Pasos

subhero.en: You have 90 days from the date your Alabama Medicaid coverage ended to enroll in an ACA marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. Alabama does not expand Medicaid for most adults, so the marketplace is likely your primary path forward.
subhero.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid en Alabama para inscribirse en un plan del mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your Alabama Medicaid termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de su Medicaid en Alabama

body.en: Your 90-day Special Enrollment Period runs from your Medicaid termination date through 90 days later. For example, if Alabama Medicaid ends June 15, 2026, your SEP window closes September 13, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until the 2027 ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026, leaving you uninsured for months. File your Medicaid appeal AND apply for marketplace coverage simultaneously to prevent any gap.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias comienza desde la fecha de terminacion de su Medicaid. Por ejemplo, si el Medicaid de Alabama termina el 15 de junio de 2026, su ventana del SEP cierra el 13 de septiembre de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre de 2026. Presente su apelacion Y solicite cobertura del mercado al mismo tiempo.

quickAnswer.en: Losing Alabama Medicaid in 2026 triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in an ACA marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. Alabama is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, so re-qualifying for Alabama Medicaid as a non-disabled adult without dependents is extremely difficult. Your realistic options are: (1) enroll in an ACA marketplace plan with premium tax credits if your 2026 income is between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single person), (2) check whether your children qualify for Alabama's ALL Kids CHIP program regardless of your own coverage, or (3) appeal the Medicaid termination if it was a procedural error. Apply through healthcare.gov within 90 days of your termination notice.
quickAnswer.es: Perder el Medicaid de Alabama en 2026 activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov. Alabama es uno de 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA, por lo que volver a calificar para Medicaid en Alabama como adulto sin discapacidad y sin dependientes es extremadamente dificil. Sus opciones reales son: (1) inscribirse en un plan del mercado ACA con creditos fiscales si su ingreso 2026 esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para una persona), (2) verificar si sus hijos califican para ALL Kids (CHIP de Alabama), o (3) apelar la terminacion de Medicaid si fue un error de procedimiento.

introParagraphs.en: Alabama Medicaid covers a narrow set of populations: children, pregnant women, elderly adults, people with qualifying disabilities, and some parents of minor children under a very low income threshold (typically under 18% FPL for parents). Losing Alabama Medicaid in 2026 almost always means one of three things happened: a redetermination found your income now exceeds the threshold, a household or dependency change removed categorical eligibility, or an administrative error flagged your case incorrectly. Alabama is one of 10 non-expansion states, meaning non-disabled adults between 18 and 64 who do not have qualifying dependents typically cannot re-enroll in traditional Medicaid regardless of income. That makes the ACA marketplace through healthcare.gov the primary path forward for most adults who lose Alabama Medicaid coverage. Premium tax credits are income-based and require projected 2026 household income between 100% and 400% of the Federal Poverty Level. For a single adult, that range is $15,960 to $63,840. Alabama does not operate a state-based exchange, so all marketplace enrollment goes through the federal healthcare.gov portal.
introParagraphs.es: El Medicaid de Alabama cubre una lista estrecha de personas: ninos, mujeres embarazadas, adultos mayores, personas con discapacidades calificadoras y algunos padres de ninos menores bajo un limite de ingresos muy bajo (tipicamente por debajo del 18% FPL para padres). Perder el Medicaid de Alabama en 2026 casi siempre significa que una redeterminacion encontro que sus ingresos ahora superan el limite, un cambio en el hogar o en la dependencia elimino la elegibilidad categorica, o un error administrativo marco su caso incorrectamente. Alabama es uno de los 10 estados sin expansion del Medicaid, lo que significa que los adultos sin discapacidad entre 18 y 64 anos que no tienen dependientes calificadores tipicamente no pueden volver a inscribirse en Medicaid tradicional independientemente de sus ingresos. Eso convierte al mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov en el camino principal para la mayoria de adultos que pierden la cobertura de Medicaid de Alabama.

introParagraphs.en: Alabama Medicaid termination triggers a qualifying life event under federal ACA rules, giving you a 90-day Special Enrollment Period for marketplace plans. That 90-day window is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for other types of coverage loss, which gives you more time to compare options. During that window, you can apply for any metal-tier plan (Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum) on healthcare.gov, with premium tax credits applied automatically if your income qualifies. Children under 19 who lose Alabama Medicaid may qualify separately for Alabama's ALL Kids program (the state CHIP program), which covers children at incomes up to 312% FPL regardless of adult eligibility. Filing a Medicaid fair hearing appeal within 90 days of the termination notice preserves the possibility of Medicaid reinstatement if the termination was erroneous, while simultaneously pursuing marketplace coverage ensures no gap in care. Both paths should be initiated on the same day you receive your termination notice.
introParagraphs.es: La terminacion del Medicaid de Alabama activa un evento calificador de vida bajo las reglas federales del ACA, dandole un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para planes del mercado. Esa ventana de 90 dias es mas larga que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para otros tipos de perdida de cobertura, lo que le da mas tiempo para comparar opciones. Durante esa ventana, puede solicitar cualquier plan de nivel metalico (Bronce, Plata, Oro o Platino) en healthcare.gov, con creditos fiscales de prima aplicados automaticamente si su ingreso califica. Los ninos menores de 19 anos que pierden el Medicaid de Alabama pueden calificar por separado para el programa ALL Kids de Alabama (el programa CHIP estatal), que cubre ninos con ingresos de hasta el 312% del FPL independientemente de la elegibilidad adulta.

name.en: Read your Alabama Medicaid termination notice immediately
name.es: Lea su aviso de terminacion de Medicaid de Alabama de inmediato

text.en: Alabama Medicaid is required to mail a written notice at least 10 days before termination. The notice states the termination date, the reason, and your appeal rights. Check whether the stated reason is a procedural error (wrong income figure, missing document) versus a genuine eligibility change. The termination date on the letter is Day 0 of your 90-day SEP window. Write that date down before doing anything else.
text.es: El Medicaid de Alabama esta obligado a enviar un aviso por escrito al menos 10 dias antes de la terminacion. El aviso indica la fecha de terminacion, el motivo y sus derechos de apelacion. Verifique si el motivo indicado es un error de procedimiento (cifra de ingresos incorrecta, documento faltante) versus un cambio genuino de elegibilidad. La fecha de terminacion en la carta es el Dia 0 de su ventana de SEP de 90 dias.

name.en: File a Medicaid fair hearing appeal within 90 days
name.es: Presente una apelacion de audiencia imparcial de Medicaid en 90 dias

text.en: File a fair hearing request with the Alabama Medicaid Agency within 90 days of the termination notice by calling 1-800-362-1504 or submitting Form MAD 600B in writing. If you appeal before the termination takes effect, Alabama must continue your Medicaid during the appeal process. Gather documents to support your case: proof of current income, proof of household size, and any correspondence showing the agency used incorrect information.
text.es: Presente una solicitud de audiencia imparcial con la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama dentro de los 90 dias del aviso de terminacion llamando al 1-800-362-1504 o enviando el Formulario MAD 600B por escrito. Si apela antes de que la terminacion surta efecto, Alabama debe continuar su Medicaid durante el proceso de apelacion.

name.en: Calculate your projected 2026 household income for ACA purposes
name.es: Calcule su ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026 a efectos del ACA

text.en: The ACA marketplace uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) to determine premium tax credit eligibility. Use your projected annual income for the rest of 2026, not last year's income. Include wages, self-employment income, unemployment compensation, and Social Security if taxable. For a single adult in 2026, income between $15,960 (100% FPL) and $63,840 (400% FPL) qualifies for premium tax credits. Calculate your household size by counting yourself plus anyone you claim as a tax dependent.
text.es: El mercado ACA usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para determinar la elegibilidad para creditos fiscales. Use su ingreso anual proyectado para el resto de 2026, no el ingreso del ano pasado. Incluya salarios, ingresos por trabajo por cuenta propia, compensacion por desempleo y Seguro Social si es tributable.

name.en: Apply for an ACA marketplace plan at healthcare.gov within 90 days
name.es: Solicite un plan del mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro de 90 dias

text.en: Go to healthcare.gov and start a new application or update an existing account. Select the qualifying life event 'Loss of Medicaid or CHIP coverage' when prompted. You will need your Alabama Medicaid termination letter or notice as proof of the qualifying event. Compare Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum plans by network, premium, and deductible. Most people who qualify for premium tax credits find Silver plans offer the best value through Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR) that lower deductibles and copays.
text.es: Vaya a healthcare.gov y comience una nueva solicitud o actualice una cuenta existente. Seleccione el evento calificador de vida 'Perdida de cobertura de Medicaid o CHIP' cuando se le solicite. Necesitara su carta o aviso de terminacion del Medicaid de Alabama como prueba del evento calificador.

name.en: Check whether your children qualify for ALL Kids (Alabama CHIP)
name.es: Verifique si sus hijos califican para ALL Kids (CHIP de Alabama)

text.en: ALL Kids is Alabama's Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP), separate from adult Medicaid. Children under 19 can enroll year-round regardless of whether a parent has coverage. ALL Kids covers children with family income up to 312% FPL (about $102,960 for a family of 4 in 2026) and charges low premiums of $5 to $50 per month depending on income. Apply at allkids.org or by calling 1-888-373-5437. Children's ALL Kids enrollment is not affected by your adult Medicaid loss.
text.es: ALL Kids es el Programa de Seguro de Salud para Ninos (CHIP) de Alabama, separado del Medicaid para adultos. Los ninos menores de 19 anos pueden inscribirse todo el ano independientemente de si un padre tiene cobertura. ALL Kids cubre ninos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 312% del FPL (aproximadamente $102,960 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Solicite en allkids.org o llamando al 1-888-373-5437.

name.en: Submit documents to healthcare.gov to verify your qualifying event
name.es: Envie documentos a healthcare.gov para verificar su evento calificador

text.en: After submitting your marketplace application, healthcare.gov may ask you to upload proof of your qualifying life event within 30 days. Acceptable documents include your Alabama Medicaid termination letter, a notice showing your coverage end date, or a letter from the Alabama Medicaid Agency. Upload documents directly through your healthcare.gov account. Failure to submit proof by the deadline can result in marketplace plan cancellation, so submit documents as soon as possible after applying.
text.es: Despues de enviar su solicitud al mercado, healthcare.gov puede pedirle que cargue prueba de su evento calificador de vida dentro de los 30 dias. Los documentos aceptables incluyen su carta de terminacion del Medicaid de Alabama, un aviso que muestre la fecha de fin de cobertura, o una carta de la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama.

name.en: Compare your 1095-A and reconcile subsidies when you file your 2026 taxes
name.es: Compare su 1095-A y reconcilie los subsidios cuando presente sus impuestos de 2026

text.en: After enrolling in a marketplace plan, you will receive Form 1095-A in early 2027. Use this to complete IRS Form 8962 to reconcile your premium tax credits against actual 2026 income. If you underestimated income, you will repay some credits. If you overestimated, you will receive a refund. Report any significant 2026 income changes to healthcare.gov as they occur during the year to keep your advance premium tax credits (APTC) accurate.
text.es: Despues de inscribirse en un plan del mercado, recibira el Formulario 1095-A a principios de 2027. Uselo para completar el Formulario IRS 8962 para reconciliar sus creditos fiscales de prima con el ingreso real de 2026. Si subestimo sus ingresos, devolvera algunos creditos. Si sobrestimo, recibira un reembolso.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes Alabama residents make after losing Medicaid coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen los residentes de Alabama despues de perder la cobertura de Medicaid en 2026:

items.en: Assuming re-enrollment in Alabama Medicaid is possible as a non-disabled adult. Alabama has not expanded Medicaid, so non-disabled adults without qualifying dependents cannot re-enroll regardless of income. The marketplace is your primary path.
items.es: Asumir que la reinscripcion en Medicaid de Alabama es posible como adulto sin discapacidad. Alabama no ha expandido Medicaid, por lo que los adultos sin discapacidad sin dependientes calificadores no pueden reinscribirse independientemente de sus ingresos. El mercado es su camino principal.

items.en: Missing the 90-day SEP window. Unlike most SEPs which last 60 days, the Medicaid loss SEP is 90 days. Missing it means waiting until the 2027 ACA Open Enrollment (November 2026) to get marketplace coverage, leaving months uninsured.
items.es: Perder la ventana de SEP de 90 dias. A diferencia de la mayoria de los SEP que duran 60 dias, el SEP por perdida de Medicaid es de 90 dias. Perderlo significa esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA 2027 (noviembre 2026) para obtener cobertura del mercado.

items.en: Not filing a Medicaid appeal simultaneously with the marketplace application. If the termination was a procedural error (wrong income figure, document not received), the appeal can reinstate your Medicaid. You lose nothing by filing an appeal at the same time as your marketplace application.
items.es: No presentar una apelacion de Medicaid simultaneamente con la solicitud del mercado. Si la terminacion fue un error de procedimiento, la apelacion puede restablecer su Medicaid. No pierde nada al presentar una apelacion al mismo tiempo que su solicitud del mercado.

items.en: Using last year's income for subsidy calculations instead of projected 2026 income. If your income dropped significantly after losing Medicaid-qualifying income, you likely qualify for larger subsidies or even $0-premium plans at healthcare.gov.
items.es: Usar el ingreso del ano pasado para los calculos de subsidios en lugar del ingreso proyectado para 2026. Si sus ingresos cayeron significativamente despues de perder el ingreso calificador para Medicaid, probablemente califica para subsidios mas grandes o incluso planes con prima de $0 en healthcare.gov.

items.en: Forgetting children's coverage. Alabama ALL Kids (CHIP) enrollment is year-round and completely separate from adult Medicaid. Children can remain on or join ALL Kids at incomes up to 312% FPL even if you do not qualify for any adult coverage.
items.es: Olvidar la cobertura de los ninos. La inscripcion en Alabama ALL Kids (CHIP) es todo el ano y completamente separada del Medicaid para adultos. Los ninos pueden permanecer o unirse a ALL Kids con ingresos de hasta el 312% del FPL aunque usted no califique para ninguna cobertura para adultos.

items.en: Purchasing a short-term limited duration plan as a replacement for Medicaid. Short-term plans sold in Alabama typically exclude pre-existing conditions, have very high deductibles, and do not count as minimum essential coverage. They are gap products, not real health coverage.
items.es: Comprar un plan de duracion limitada a corto plazo como reemplazo de Medicaid. Los planes a corto plazo vendidos en Alabama tipicamente excluyen condiciones preexistentes, tienen deducibles muy altos y no cuentan como cobertura esencial minima. Son productos de brecha, no cobertura medica real.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace vs Alabama Medicaid Re-enrollment vs COBRA: Which Path Is Right for You?
heading.es: Mercado ACA vs Reinscripcion Medicaid Alabama vs COBRA: Cual Es el Camino Correcto para Usted?

body.en: After losing Alabama Medicaid in 2026, three paths exist, but only one is realistic for most non-disabled adults. Alabama Medicaid re-enrollment requires meeting categorical eligibility rules: being pregnant, having children under 19, being 65 or older, being blind or disabled, or being a parent of a minor child with income under roughly 18% FPL (approximately $2,700/year for a single parent in 2026). Non-disabled childless adults cannot qualify for Alabama Medicaid regardless of income. ACA marketplace plans through healthcare.gov are the primary path for adults losing Alabama Medicaid. Premium tax credits make Silver-tier plans cost $0 to $300 per month for most people with income between 100% and 400% FPL in 2026. The one critical warning for 2026: the ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026, after enhanced Premium Tax Credits from the American Rescue Plan expired. Adults with income above 400% FPL ($63,840 single) receive no federal subsidy and face full unsubsidized premiums. COBRA applies only if you also recently had employer-sponsored coverage before or alongside your Medicaid coverage. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, typically $400 to $900 per month for an individual, and is almost always more expensive than a marketplace plan with subsidies. The decision matrix for Alabama adults in 2026 is: check categorical Medicaid eligibility first (pregnant, elderly, disabled); then apply for the marketplace within the 90-day SEP; COBRA only if marketplace options do not include your current specialist or hospital network.
body.es: Despues de perder el Medicaid de Alabama en 2026, existen tres caminos, pero solo uno es realista para la mayoria de adultos sin discapacidad. La reinscripcion en Medicaid de Alabama requiere cumplir las reglas de elegibilidad categorica: estar embarazada, tener hijos menores de 19 anos, tener 65 anos o mas, ser ciego o discapacitado, o ser padre de un menor con ingresos por debajo de aproximadamente el 18% del FPL. Los adultos sin discapacidad sin hijos no pueden calificar para el Medicaid de Alabama independientemente de sus ingresos. Los planes del mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov son el camino principal para los adultos que pierden el Medicaid de Alabama. Los creditos fiscales de prima hacen que los planes Silver cuesten de $0 a $300 al mes para la mayoria de personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% del FPL en 2026. COBRA solo aplica si recientemente tambien tenia cobertura patrocinada por el empleador. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima grupal completa, tipicamente $400 a $900 al mes para un individuo, y casi siempre es mas caro que un plan del mercado con subsidios.

heading.en: Alabama Medicaid Eligibility in 2026: Who Can Still Qualify
heading.es: Elegibilidad para Medicaid en Alabama en 2026: Quien Aun Puede Calificar

paragraphs.en: Alabama Medicaid eligibility in 2026 remains categorically restricted because Alabama has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA. Adults who may still qualify include: children under 19 through ALL Kids or traditional Medicaid, pregnant women (income up to 146% FPL), adults 65 and older (income and asset limits apply), blind or disabled adults receiving SSI or meeting SSA disability criteria, and parents or caretaker relatives of minor children with income below roughly 18% FPL (approximately $3,700 per year for a household of 2). Non-disabled adults under 65 without dependent children do not qualify for Alabama Medicaid regardless of income. This is the coverage gap: people who earn too much for categorical Medicaid but below 100% FPL cannot access ACA subsidies either. The Alabama Medicaid Agency website at medicaid.alabama.gov provides current eligibility guidelines and a list of required documentation for each category.
paragraphs.es: La elegibilidad para Medicaid en Alabama en 2026 sigue siendo categoricamente restringida porque Alabama no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA. Los adultos que aun pueden calificar incluyen: ninos menores de 19 anos a traves de ALL Kids o Medicaid tradicional, mujeres embarazadas (ingresos hasta el 146% del FPL), adultos de 65 anos o mas, adultos ciegos o discapacitados que reciben SSI o cumplen los criterios de discapacidad de la SSA, y padres o parientes cuidadores de menores con ingresos por debajo de aproximadamente el 18% del FPL. Los adultos sin discapacidad menores de 65 anos sin hijos dependientes no califican para Medicaid en Alabama independientemente de sus ingresos.

heading.en: Alabama's Coverage Gap: What Happens If Your Income Is Below 100% FPL
heading.es: La Brecha de Cobertura en Alabama: Que Pasa Si Sus Ingresos Estan Por Debajo del 100% FPL

paragraphs.en: Alabama's coverage gap in 2026 affects adults who earn below 100% FPL ($15,060 single / $31,200 family of 4) but do not meet categorical Medicaid criteria. ACA premium tax credits require income at or above 100% FPL, so adults below that threshold cannot receive subsidized marketplace plans either. Approximately 240,000 Alabamians fall into this gap according to KFF estimates. These individuals have limited options: emergency Medicaid (covers emergency services only for categorically ineligible adults), federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) which charge sliding-scale fees regardless of insurance status, free clinics in major Alabama cities (Birmingham, Huntsville, Montgomery, Mobile), and pharmaceutical manufacturer patient assistance programs for prescription medications. If your income rises above 100% FPL during the year, you immediately become eligible for ACA marketplace subsidies and should apply through healthcare.gov using the Special Enrollment Period for change in income. The Alabama Department of Public Health operates a network of county health departments that provide some primary care services on a sliding-fee basis.
paragraphs.es: La brecha de cobertura de Alabama en 2026 afecta a adultos que ganan por debajo del 100% del FPL ($15,060 individual / $31,200 familia de 4) pero no cumplen los criterios categoricos de Medicaid. Los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA requieren ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del FPL, por lo que los adultos por debajo de ese umbral tampoco pueden recibir planes del mercado subsidiados. Aproximadamente 240,000 residentes de Alabama caen en esta brecha segun estimaciones de KFF. Estas personas tienen opciones limitadas: Medicaid de emergencia, centros de salud calificados federalmente (FQHC) que cobran tarifas en escala movil, clinicas gratuitas en las principales ciudades de Alabama, y programas de asistencia al paciente de fabricantes de medicamentos. Si sus ingresos suben por encima del 100% del FPL durante el ano, inmediatamente se vuelve elegible para subsidios del mercado ACA y debe solicitar a traves de healthcare.gov usando el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por cambio de ingresos.

heading.en: How to Appeal an Alabama Medicaid Termination in 2026
heading.es: Como Apelar una Terminacion de Medicaid en Alabama en 2026

paragraphs.en: Alabama Medicaid terminations can be appealed through the state's fair hearing process. The appeal must be filed within 90 days of the termination notice date. Filing before the termination takes effect preserves continuation of benefits during the appeal. Three steps initiate the appeal process: first, call the Alabama Medicaid Agency at 1-800-362-1504 and request a fair hearing; second, submit your request in writing using Form MAD 600B, which you can download from medicaid.alabama.gov or request at any county Department of Human Resources office; third, gather supporting documents that contradict the reason for termination (pay stubs if income was overstated, proof of household size if dependency was disputed, documentation of disability if categorical status was questioned). Alabama typically schedules fair hearings within 45 days of the request. If you win the appeal, Medicaid is reinstated retroactively and any claims paid out of pocket during the gap are reimbursed. If you lose, you can request a state agency review and then pursue federal administrative review through CMS. While the appeal is pending, apply for marketplace coverage through healthcare.gov to ensure continuous coverage in case the appeal is unsuccessful.
paragraphs.es: Las terminaciones de Medicaid en Alabama se pueden apelar a traves del proceso de audiencia imparcial del estado. La apelacion debe presentarse dentro de los 90 dias de la fecha del aviso de terminacion. Presentar la apelacion antes de que la terminacion surta efecto preserva la continuacion de los beneficios durante la apelacion. Tres pasos inician el proceso de apelacion: primero, llame a la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama al 1-800-362-1504 y solicite una audiencia imparcial; segundo, presente su solicitud por escrito usando el Formulario MAD 600B; tercero, reuna documentos de respaldo que contradigan el motivo de la terminacion. Alabama generalmente programa las audiencias imparciales dentro de los 45 dias de la solicitud. Si gana la apelacion, Medicaid se restablece retroactivamente. Mientras la apelacion esta pendiente, solicite cobertura del mercado a traves de healthcare.gov para garantizar cobertura continua.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace Plans in Alabama: What to Expect in 2026
heading.es: Planes del Mercado ACA en Alabama: Que Esperar en 2026

paragraphs.en: Alabama uses the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov, not a state-based exchange. The 2026 ACA Open Enrollment Period (OEP) for Alabama ran November 1, 2025 through January 15, 2026. Because you are enrolling outside the OEP using the Medicaid-loss SEP, you can enroll in any metal-tier plan available in your Alabama ZIP code. Major insurers offering plans in Alabama in 2026 include Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama, UnitedHealthcare, and Ambetter from Magnolia Health (a Centene subsidiary). Alabama's marketplace tends to have limited carrier competition outside major metro areas like Birmingham, Huntsville, and Mobile. Silver-tier plans in Alabama that qualify for Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR) are the most valuable option for people with income between 100% and 250% FPL: CSR reduces your Silver plan's deductible from the standard $4,000-$6,000 range to as low as $300-$700 annually. Premium tax credits are applied as Advance Premium Tax Credits (APTC) directly to your monthly bill when you enroll. The 2026 out-of-pocket maximum for ACA plans is $10,600 for an individual and $21,200 for a family. Report any income changes to healthcare.gov during the year to keep your APTC accurate and avoid a large tax reconciliation on your 2026 Form 8962.
paragraphs.es: Alabama usa el mercado federal en healthcare.gov, no un intercambio estatal. Alabama tiende a tener competencia de aseguradoras limitada fuera de las principales areas metropolitanas como Birmingham, Huntsville y Mobile. Los planes Silver en Alabama que califican para Reducciones de Costos Compartidos (CSR) son la opcion mas valiosa para personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 250% del FPL: CSR reduce el deducible de su plan Silver desde el rango estandar de $4,000-$6,000 a tan solo $300-$700 anuales. El maximo de gastos de bolsillo del ACA 2026 es de $10,600 para un individuo y $21,200 para una familia.

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in ACA coverage after losing Alabama Medicaid?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your Alabama Medicaid coverage ended to enroll in an ACA marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. This 90-day Special Enrollment Period is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for most other coverage loss events. Your 90-day window begins on your coverage termination date, not the date you received the notice. For example, if your Medicaid ends June 15, 2026, your SEP closes September 13, 2026. Apply as early as possible within that window to avoid gaps.

en.question: Can I re-enroll in Alabama Medicaid after losing it?
en.answer: Possibly, but only if you meet categorical eligibility requirements. Alabama has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, so non-disabled adults under 65 without qualifying dependents cannot re-enroll regardless of income. If you are pregnant, a parent of a minor child with very low income, elderly (65+), or disabled with SSI-linked eligibility, you may re-enroll through the Alabama Medicaid Agency at medicaid.alabama.gov or by calling 1-800-362-1504. Non-categorical adults must use the ACA marketplace through healthcare.gov instead.

en.question: What is the Alabama coverage gap and am I in it?
en.answer: The Alabama coverage gap in 2026 affects adults who earn below 100% FPL (under $15,060 single / $31,200 family of 4) but do not meet categorical Medicaid criteria (pregnant, elderly, disabled, or parent of minor under strict income limits). ACA premium tax credits require income at or above 100% FPL, so gap adults cannot access subsidized marketplace plans either. If you are in the gap, options include federally qualified health centers (FQHCs) with sliding-scale fees, free clinics in Alabama cities, and emergency Medicaid for acute care only. If your income rises above 100% FPL, apply immediately at healthcare.gov using a change-in-income SEP.

en.question: Does losing Alabama Medicaid affect my children's ALL Kids coverage?
en.answer: No. ALL Kids (Alabama CHIP) is a separate program with its own eligibility rules. Children under 19 can remain enrolled in or newly join ALL Kids regardless of your adult Medicaid status. ALL Kids covers children with family income up to 312% FPL (roughly $92,124 for a family of 4 in 2026) and charges low monthly premiums of $5 to $50 depending on income. Enrollment is year-round with no SEP requirement. Apply or check eligibility at allkids.org or by calling 1-888-373-5437. Do not dis-enroll children from ALL Kids when an adult loses Medicaid.

en.question: How do I document the Alabama Medicaid loss for the healthcare.gov application?
en.answer: Healthcare.gov will ask you to verify your qualifying life event after you apply. The primary document is your Alabama Medicaid termination letter, which states your coverage end date, the reason for termination, and your appeal rights. Keep a copy of this letter. If you did not receive a letter, call the Alabama Medicaid Agency at 1-800-362-1504 and request written confirmation of your coverage end date. Healthcare.gov typically gives you 30 days to upload proof after applying. Failure to submit documentation by the deadline can result in plan cancellation. Upload your termination notice or confirmation letter directly through your healthcare.gov account.

en.question: What happens if I miss the 90-day SEP after losing Alabama Medicaid?
en.answer: Missing the 90-day SEP means you cannot enroll in a marketplace plan until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period in November 2026 (for 2027 coverage). Coverage would begin January 1, 2027, leaving a gap of potentially several months. During that gap, you would be uninsured unless another qualifying life event occurs (job gain with employer coverage, marriage, birth, or moving to a new county with different plan availability). Alabama ALL Kids remains available year-round for children under 19 regardless of adult SEP timing. If you think the termination was an error, file a Medicaid fair hearing appeal within 90 days to preserve Medicaid reinstatement rights.

en.question: Should I file a Medicaid appeal even if I plan to use the ACA marketplace?
en.answer: Yes. Filing a fair hearing appeal with the Alabama Medicaid Agency does not prevent you from also applying for marketplace coverage. Both actions should happen simultaneously. If your termination was a procedural error (wrong income figure, document not received, household change misprocessed), winning the appeal reinstates your Medicaid retroactively, which is free coverage. If you lose the appeal, your marketplace plan is already in place. There is no downside to filing the appeal. Call 1-800-362-1504 or submit Form MAD 600B in writing within 90 days of your termination notice date.

en.question: What ACA plans are available through healthcare.gov in Alabama in 2026?
en.answer: Alabama uses the federal marketplace at healthcare.gov. Major insurers in Alabama in 2026 include Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama, UnitedHealthcare, and Ambetter from Magnolia Health. Plan availability varies significantly by county and ZIP code. Rural Alabama counties often have one or two carriers; Birmingham, Huntsville, Mobile, and Montgomery metropolitan areas have more options. Use the plan comparison tool at healthcare.gov to see all plans available in your ZIP code. Silver plans with Cost-Sharing Reductions (CSR) are best for most people with income between 100% and 250% FPL since CSR can reduce your annual deductible from $4,000 to $6,000 down to $300 to $700, making actual healthcare much more affordable than the premium alone suggests.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en cobertura del ACA despues de perder el Medicaid de Alabama?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid en Alabama para inscribirse en un plan del mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov. Este Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para la mayoria de otros eventos de perdida de cobertura. Su ventana de 90 dias comienza en la fecha de terminacion de su cobertura, no en la fecha en que recibio el aviso. Por ejemplo, si su Medicaid termina el 15 de junio de 2026, su SEP cierra el 13 de septiembre de 2026.

es.question: Puedo reinscribirme en Medicaid de Alabama despues de perderlo?
es.answer: Posiblemente, pero solo si cumple los requisitos de elegibilidad categorica. Alabama no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA, por lo que los adultos sin discapacidad menores de 65 anos sin dependientes calificadores no pueden reinscribirse independientemente de sus ingresos. Si esta embarazada, es padre de un menor con ingresos muy bajos, es anciano (65+), o tiene discapacidad vinculada al SSI, puede reinscribirse a traves de la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama en medicaid.alabama.gov o llamando al 1-800-362-1504. Los adultos no categoricos deben usar el mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov.

es.question: Que es la brecha de cobertura de Alabama y estoy en ella?
es.answer: La brecha de cobertura de Alabama en 2026 afecta a adultos que ganan por debajo del 100% del FPL (menos de $15,060 individual / $31,200 familia de 4) pero no cumplen los criterios categoricos de Medicaid. Los creditos fiscales de prima del ACA requieren ingresos iguales o superiores al 100% del FPL, por lo que los adultos en la brecha tampoco pueden acceder a planes del mercado subsidiados. Las opciones incluyen centros de salud calificados federalmente con tarifas en escala movil, clinicas gratuitas en ciudades de Alabama, y Medicaid de emergencia solo para atencion aguda. Si sus ingresos suben por encima del 100% del FPL, solicite inmediatamente en healthcare.gov.

es.question: Perder el Medicaid de Alabama afecta la cobertura ALL Kids de mis hijos?
es.answer: No. ALL Kids (CHIP de Alabama) es un programa separado con sus propias reglas de elegibilidad. Los ninos menores de 19 anos pueden permanecer inscritos o unirse nuevamente a ALL Kids independientemente de su estado de Medicaid para adultos. ALL Kids cubre ninos con ingresos familiares de hasta el 312% del FPL (aproximadamente $102,960 para una familia de 4 en 2026) y cobra primas mensuales bajas de $5 a $50. La inscripcion es todo el ano. Solicite o verifique la elegibilidad en allkids.org o llamando al 1-888-373-5437.

es.question: Como documento la perdida del Medicaid de Alabama para la solicitud de healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Healthcare.gov le pedira que verifique su evento calificador de vida despues de solicitar. El documento principal es su carta de terminacion del Medicaid de Alabama, que indica la fecha de fin de cobertura, el motivo de la terminacion y sus derechos de apelacion. Si no recibio una carta, llame a la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama al 1-800-362-1504 y solicite confirmacion escrita de su fecha de fin de cobertura. Healthcare.gov generalmente le da 30 dias para cargar pruebas despues de solicitar. No enviar documentacion puede resultar en la cancelacion del plan.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo el SEP de 90 dias despues de perder el Medicaid de Alabama?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 90 dias significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan del mercado hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 (para cobertura 2027). La cobertura comenzaria el 1 de enero de 2027, dejando una brecha de posiblemente varios meses. Durante esa brecha, estaria sin seguro a menos que ocurra otro evento calificador de vida. ALL Kids de Alabama sigue disponible todo el ano para ninos menores de 19 anos. Si cree que la terminacion fue un error, presente una apelacion de audiencia imparcial de Medicaid dentro de los 90 dias para preservar los derechos de restablecimiento de Medicaid.

es.question: Debo presentar una apelacion de Medicaid aunque planee usar el mercado ACA?
es.answer: Si. Presentar una apelacion de audiencia imparcial con la Agencia de Medicaid de Alabama no le impide tambien solicitar cobertura del mercado. Ambas acciones deben ocurrir simultaneamente. Si su terminacion fue un error de procedimiento, ganar la apelacion restablece su Medicaid retroactivamente, que es cobertura gratuita. Si pierde la apelacion, su plan del mercado ya esta en su lugar. No hay desventaja en presentar la apelacion. Llame al 1-800-362-1504 o envie el Formulario MAD 600B por escrito dentro de los 90 dias.

es.question: Que planes del ACA estan disponibles a traves de healthcare.gov en Alabama en 2026?
es.answer: Alabama usa el mercado federal en healthcare.gov. Los principales aseguradores en Alabama en 2026 incluyen Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Alabama, UnitedHealthcare y Ambetter de Magnolia Health. La disponibilidad de planes varia significativamente por condado y codigo postal. Los condados rurales de Alabama a menudo tienen uno o dos aseguradores. Use la herramienta de comparacion de planes en healthcare.gov para ver todos los planes disponibles en su codigo postal. Los planes Silver con Reducciones de Costos Compartidos (CSR) son los mejores para la mayoria de personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 250% del FPL, ya que CSR puede reducir su deducible anual de $4,000-$6,000 a $300-$700.
